review.notes: Chain starts at v1 (LCGX-EN217, 2011-10-04), which the baseline implements exactly (ratio 1.0). v0 (SOVR-EN099, 2009-11-17) -> v1 is the PSCT formalisation of the same mandatory Trigger Effects, so the Edison-era printing (v0, in force from 2009-11-17) behaves as the baseline implements. The 'Once per turn' wording added at v2 has no script counterpart - both scripts already apply SetCountLimit(1) to the End Phase pay-500-or-destroy maintenance - so the recorded behavioural difference is the Trigger-to-continuous and targeting change. Upstream also ships 511000306 'Clear World (VG)', the video-game version with materially different text ('You cannot activate Spell Cards'; 'Once per turn, during your turn: Destroy 1 monster you control'; DARK stops all attacks rather than only at 2+ monsters) - not a TCG historical version, excluded. Remaining modern-only code (the fid / STATUS_COPYING_EFFECT guards and the EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE marker effect) is upstream robustness for effect-copying, not an erratum. Card data identical between 33900658 and 33900648.

effective.basis: TCG release of Maze of the Master (MZTM-EN098), the first printing carrying the errata'd text

event.historical_text: During each of your End Phases, pay 500 Life Points or destroy this card. Each player receives effects, depending on the monster Attributes they control. ● LIGHT: Play with your hand revealed at all times. ● DARK: If you control 2 or more monsters, you cannot declare an attack. ● EARTH: During your Standby Phase: Target 1 face-up Defense Position monster you control; destroy that target. ● WATER: During your End Phase: Discard 1 card. ● FIRE: During your End Phase: Take 1000 damage. ● WIND: You must pay 500 Life Points to activate a Spell Card.
event.modern_text: Once per turn, during your End Phase, pay 500 LP or destroy this card. Each player receives effects, depending on the monster Attributes they control.● LIGHT: Play with your hand revealed at all times.● DARK: If you control 2 or more monsters, you cannot declare an attack.● EARTH: During your Standby Phase, destroy 1 face-up Defense Position monster you control.● WATER: During your End Phase, discard 1 card.● FIRE: During your End Phase, take 1000 damage.● WIND: You must pay 500 LP to activate a Spell Card.
event.summary: Functional erratum: the EARTH, WATER and FIRE penalties stopped being Trigger Effects that start a Chain. The historical script registers all three as EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD+EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_F with EFFECT_FLAG_EVENT_PLAYER - mandatory triggers that form a chain link and can be responded to or negated - and gives the EARTH one EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET plus a SetTarget(s.destg) that targets the Defense Position monster at activation; the modern script registers the same three as EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD+EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS with no target step, so nothing is targeted and nothing can be chained to. The printed text tracks it: v1's 'During your Standby Phase: Target 1 face-up Defense Position monster you control; destroy that target' becomes v2's 'During your Standby Phase, destroy 1 face-up Defense Position monster you control', and the maintenance clause gains 'Once per turn'.
